meta.title: Data + AI: agents inside and around Snowflake
meta.description: Agents that reason over governed data inside Snowflake and act in the tools teams already use, and the interplay between them. Built with Claude as an Anthropic partner, in production in 8–16 weeks.

hero.title: Agents that act where work happens, <hl>on data teams can trust.</hl>
hero.description: The value of artificial intelligence shows up when agents reason over governed data inside Snowflake and take the next action in the tools teams already use. We build both, and the interplay between them, with Claude as an Anthropic partner. Proven small first, in production in 8–16 weeks.

how.title: Two planes, one governed loop
how.intro: An AI agent is software that reasons over governed data and then takes the next action itself, running as a verifiable identity with per-agent permissions and a full audit trail. Agent engineering runs in two places. Inside Snowflake, agents reason over governed data without moving it. In the flow of work, Claude takes the next action where teams already are. The point is the interplay: a request crosses both and comes back cited, in policy, and logged.

ship.title: Six jobs, running across both planes.
ship.intro: Each one reasons over governed data inside Snowflake and shows up where teams work. Where a real engagement proves it, the numbers are on the card.

useCases.title: Paperwork that reads itself
useCases.body: Claims, invoices, and contracts classified, extracted, and routed in seconds instead of hand-sorted piles. The document backlog becomes a table teams can query.

useCases.title: Executives who ask the data directly
useCases.body: Plain-language questions answered with citations against governed definitions, so the Monday meeting starts from the same number, not three versions of it.
useCases.stat: Thousands of runaway SKUs, one catalog agent

useCases.title: Churn and failures, flagged early
useCases.body: Models on usage, billing, and sensor data that surface at-risk customers and equipment before the quarter ends, with the reasons attached.

useCases.title: Documents, searched by meaning
useCases.body: Policies, contracts, and wikis answered directly, with sources cited. Retrieval grounded in the organization's own content, so answers stay accurate and current.

useCases.title: Agents that act, inside policy
useCases.body: AI that does the next step, not just describes it: drafting the response, filing the update, kicking off the workflow, each action inside per-agent permissions with a full audit trail.

useCases.title: AI where teams already work
useCases.body: Answers and actions flowing back into the ERP, CRM, and apps the business runs on, so nobody has to visit another dashboard to benefit.

useCasesFootnote: A use case we haven't listed? If the data can carry it, we can ship it. <link>Tell us the job →</link>

governed.title: One perimeter, one identity, both planes
governed.body: AI governance is not a separate layer here. Inference runs inside the business's Snowflake account, so prompts and results stay within the same perimeter as the data. Agents in the field reach it through governed endpoints, never raw copies, acting as verifiable identities with per-agent permissions. Access, masking, and lineage carry across both planes, and Cortex guardrails screen every call.
